subject.title: [F6] Zero-duration spans indicate missing duration instrumentation

question: Should trajectory JSONL rows gain a duration/start-end span contract, and which reported event types should become measured lifecycle spans versus remain point-in-time events?
rationale: The current exported schema is event-based, so fixing this by adding durations changes a diagnostic data contract and requires maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Add additive timing fields
options.body: Define `durationMs` or start/end fields for real lifecycle operations and update trajectory export, OTel mapping, docs, and tests around that contract.

options.title: Keep trajectory event-only
options.body: Leave trajectory JSONL as point events, route measured latency work through OTel diagnostics, and clarify the trajectory docs so zero-duration point rows are expected.

options.title: Split by event family
options.body: Track runtime lifecycle spans separately from transcript-derived tool call/result reconstruction so each event family gets the right schema.

recommendation.title: Add additive timing fields
recommendation.body: Define `durationMs` or start/end fields for real lifecycle operations and update trajectory export, OTel mapping, docs, and tests around that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the trajectory bundle/export surface that the schema decision would change.
